module_summary: Timer-control FSM: detects 1101 on serial data, enables shifting 4 cycles, waits for done_counting, then asserts done until ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Enum state register: pattern search, 4 shift states, Count and Wait; decodes all outputs.

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Enables external duration shift register during states B0-B3.

anchors.name: counting
anchors.why: Level output in Count state telling datapath counters to run.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Timeout notification held in Wait state until user ack.

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledge returning FSM from Wait to pattern search.

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: Counter completion input moving FSM from Count to Wait.

groups.name: timer_fsm
groups.description: Pattern detector, shift sequencing, count wait and done/ack handshake in one FSM.
